# 💳 gws Docs

💳 Requires a paid Google Workspace account for the gws CLI — no free tier. Curated by Skill Harbor — the Docs module of the gws CLI: read and write Google Docs from the terminal (`gws docs <resource> <method> [flags]`), with API resources documented (documents batchUpdate/create/get), schema discovery before calling any method, and a `+write` helper for appending text. Pairs with the sibling subcommand skills gws-docs-write, gws-sheets-read, gws-drive-upload and gws-gmail-triage. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: it documents CLI usage — you still need the gws binary installed and authenticated; the shared auth/security rules live in a separate gws-shared skill the agent must read first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
